# elmah.io Blog

> Tutorials and guides on .NET development, error handling, and performance — from the team behind elmah.io, the error logging and uptime monitoring service for .NET.

- [EF Core query translation: Why does some LINQ never become SQL?](https://blog.elmah.io/ef-core-query-translation-why-does-some-linq-never-become-sql/)

- [12 practices for optimizing PostgreSQL queries for large datasets](https://blog.elmah.io/12-practices-for-optimizing-postgresql-queries-for-large-datasets/)
- [Simplifying file logging in ASP.NET Core with Serilog](https://blog.elmah.io/simplifying-file-logging-in-asp-net-core-with-serilog/)
